name: Tapas
description: Small savoury dishes, typically served with drinks in Spanish bars — from patatas bravas to jamón ibérico. A social way to eat like a local.

name: Fresh Spring Rolls
description: Rice-paper rolls stuffed with herbs, vermicelli and prawns, served fresh with a peanut dipping sauce. Light, fragrant and endlessly repeatable.

name: Sushi
description: Vinegared rice topped or rolled with fresh seafood and vegetables — the definitive bite of Japanese cuisine.

name: Pizza Napoletana
description: Thin-crust wood-fired pizza from Naples with San Marzano tomatoes, mozzarella and fresh basil.

name: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tofu, shrimp and tamarind sauce — sweet, sour and salty in one wok.

name: Croissant
description: Buttery, flaky viennoiserie — the essential companion to a Parisian café breakfast.

name: Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced meat or vegetables — a celebratory one-pot feast.

name: Mohinga
description: Myanmar's national dish — a comforting fish-based noodle soup with lemongrass, ginger and crispy fritters.
